{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out all QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Now, extract loyal customers from clean data
loyal_mask = df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
converted_loyal = df_clean[loyal_mask]['converted']

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = converted_loyal.mean()

# Return the fraction as a float
conversion_rate"}
